title: Primary corpus inputs and resident graph state have no bounded retention policy
wanted_capability: One coherent retention policy that bounds transcript documents, transcript-derived resident edges, vector records, and Git-history projections by age and/or byte budget while preserving an explicit cold-history or deliberate-drop contract. Ingest, boot hydration, reindex, and background eviction must agree on the same policy.
missing_primitive: Configurable primary-corpus retention and coordinated eviction across Tantivy documents, EdgeIndex hydration, vector partitions, and Git-history projections.
fallback_used: Operational memory limits, allocator tuning, and secondary-store GC bound symptoms but do not bound primary corpus growth.
notes: The root design-request document is being normalized into design/corpus/storage/corpus-retention-and-residency.md. Keep process-memory diagnostics separate under gap-bcced6fb; snapshot count/byte retention was separately addressed by gap-efd270dd.
